import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int n, t, rx, ry;
    static String[] lab, sci;
    static int[][][][][] mem;
    static int[][] dist;
    static int[][] vis;

    static boolean good(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n && 0 <= y && y < n && lab[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && lab[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }

    static void pre() {
        dist = new int[n][n];
        vis = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
            Arrays.fill(vis[i], 0);
        }
        dist[rx][ry] = 0;
        vis[rx][ry] = 1;
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        qx.add(rx);
        qy.add(ry);
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qx.poll();
            int y = qy.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k];
                int ny = y + dy[k];
                if (good(nx, ny) && vis[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    qx.add(nx);
                    qy.add(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean canReach(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int ptr) {
        if (ptr > t) return false;
        int ret = mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr];
        if (ret != -1) return ret == 1;
        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) {
            boolean res = dist[x0][y0] >= ptr;
            mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = res ? 1 : 0;
            return res;
        }
        if (dist[x0][y0] <= ptr) {
            mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = 0;
            return false;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int nx = x0 + dx[k];
            int ny = y0 + dy[k];
            if (good(nx, ny) && canReach(nx, ny, x1, y1, ptr + 1)) {
                mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = 0;
        return false;
    }

    static class Dinic {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev, cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;
        int[] level, it;
        Dinic(int n) {
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            it = new int[n];
        }
        void addEdge(int v, int to, int cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(to, g.get(to).size(), cap);
            Edge b = new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), 0);
            g.get(v).add(a);
            g.get(to).add(b);
        }
        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(v)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] >= 0;
        }
        int dfsFlow(int v, int t, int f) {
            if (v == t) return f;
            for (; it[v] < g.get(v).size(); it[v]++) {
                Edge e = g.get(v).get(it[v]);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] + 1 == level[e.to]) {
                    int ret = dfsFlow(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (ret > 0) {
                        e.cap -= ret;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += ret;
                        return ret;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
        int maxflow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            final int INF = 1000000000;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(it, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = dfsFlow(s, t, INF);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        sci = new String[n];
        lab = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) sci[i] = sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) lab[i] = sc.nextLine();

        ArrayList<int[]> pos = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer> lc = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer> scList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = sci[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    pos.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    lc.add(lab[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    scList.add(c - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        int m = pos.size();
        pre();

        mem = new int[12][12][12][12][62];
        for (int a = 0; a < 12; a++)
            for (int b = 0; b < 12; b++)
                for (int c = 0; c < 12; c++)
                    for (int d = 0; d < 12; d++)
                        Arrays.fill(mem[a][b][c][d], -1);

        Dinic din = new Dinic(2 * m + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            din.addEdge(0, i + 1, scList.get(i));
            din.addEdge(m + 1 + i, 2 * m + 1, lc.get(i));
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if (canReach(pos.get(i)[0], pos.get(i)[1], pos.get(j)[0], pos.get(j)[1], 0)) {
                    din.addEdge(i + 1, m + 1 + j, 1000);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(din.maxflow(0, 2 * m + 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
